chunks: Saying: "O Lord, forgive me, and give me such a dominion as none will merit after me. You are the great bestower."
ai.seo_question: What was the specific prayer of Prophet Sulaiman when he received his kingdom?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between the prophetic kingdom of Sulaiman, which was unique and non--hereditary, and the eternal spiritual authority (Imamate) granted to the Ahl al-Bayt. The supplication underscores the divine bestowal of a dominion defined by absolute sovereignty and wisdom, serving as a prototype for the infallible Imams who inherit the Prophet's spiritual legacy.
